assumptions: Split by time: train on events that ended before the cutoff; test on markets of the remaining events that resolved after it (legs resolved earlier are dropped). Legs of one event never straddle the split.

Cost per contract = max(spread / 2, 0.01) + Polymarket taker fee (rate x p(1-p), each market's own fee schedule from Gamma; fees on) + flat fee 0.0; historical spreads are unknown, so the 1¢ floor applies.
Stakes are fractions of the starting bankroll and positions overlap: peak_open_stake is the most staked at once; capped_exposure re-runs the same trades with total open stake capped at 1 bankroll.

Policy COH: one trade per market, at the earliest horizon within 24 h of the scheduled end whose net edge is at least 1¢; in neg-risk events whose legs at that horizon sum to 0.95-1.25, q is normalised across the legs first; then only the largest net edge per event; held to resolution. 10 variants compared on validation (integrations/playoff, integrations/ensemble); the test was opened once for V3 and COH side by side.
Embargo: a test trade counts only if it was entered on/after the cutoff.
Only prices in 3%–97% are modelled or traded; edge must survive the model's 10–90% bootstrap interval (resampled by event).
Stake = 0.25 Kelly on the conservative q, capped at 5% of the starting bankroll; P&L is additive (no compounding) because positions overlap.

Entry price = the last print at or before the target time in Polymarket's hourly price history (prior prints only, at most 6 h old; 98.9% of headline trades use a print at most 1 h old, see robustness); fills at that price are assumed.
Costs = max(the market's quoted half-spread, 1¢) + Polymarket's taker fee. Historical spreads are not available, so the 1¢ floor stands in for them: a stated limitation.
